title: Pack Your Bags [DISCONTINUED]
description: Another storage mod incase you need It.
body:
![The Mod's Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/495295e7fe0355338d9196fa67a273474bcec1ef.png)Ever felt a slot short from getting that sweet loot? Well have no fear, because I introduce to you: Pack Your Bags.

Pack Your Bags is a vanilla-friendly storage mod focused on improving inventory management without breaking progression.

It adds craftable backpacks with multiple tiers, along with simple storage crates to help organize your items early and mid-game. Backpacks provide portable storage, while crates offer a compact alternative to chests.

The mod is designed to complement vanilla mechanics — not replace them — making it suitable for survival worlds and modpacks alike.
